entities.summary: Sychyovka is a town and the administrative center of Sychyovsky District in Smolensk Oblast, Russia, located between the Vazuza and Losmina Rivers, 234 kilometers (145 mi) northeast of Smolensk, the administrative center of the oblast. Population: 8,111 (2010 census); 8,683 (2002 census); 9,643 (1989 Soviet census).
